Implementation review: retain all accepted requirements, the real workbook writer and browser cleanup, and the one public query input. The current proposal is not ready for approval: analyze_landing consumes an entire observation; select/extract transforms consume whole observation page collections, including long action selectors and unrelated URLs. Completeness is prose-only; there are no enforced requires guards on authoritative manifest/capture flags.
Revise the existing composition using existing TaskPlan primitives. Obtain bounded observation-page manifests, require captureTruncated=false and manifestTruncated=false before consumption, then read every manifest cursor before any navigation or interaction invalidates it. Guard page capture completeness. Do not claim data complete from a generated status string or infer absence from an incomplete page. A capture that cannot be completed must fail explicitly. Preserve actual per-product navigation and extraction from that product's observed page.
Build separate deterministic typed business views for each interpretation consumer using nested foreach and direct field/object output bindings; complete all source items, retaining grouping, ordering and exact source references in original producer data. Consent/blockage and product-fact interpretations need visible text/control context (for example kind, tag, text, group, role), not selectorHints or incidental hrefs. Product selection needs the exact observed hrefs and relevant text/group context, but not selectors. Only pass each compact view and necessary shared context into its global interpretation, never the raw observation or manifest collection again. Do not add per-record interpretation, invented extraction fields, truncation or new limits. Use declared records as bounded elements; no hidden inference for wiring. Keep comparison/selection global. Conditional consent still uses an observed control and is followed by a fresh complete snapshot. Preserve matching exports, required results, the actual write operation and root cleanup; report paths must come from the writer. All existing budgets, policies and oracles remain unchanged.
